cost: Tree assembly O(W); predicate reading includes repeated scans, recursive phrase copying and lexicon lookup. Conservative cost O(W squared plus recursion/lexicon/rule work plus output); no finite global bound for arbitrary dependency cycles, effectful parser callbacks or configured resources.
forward: On finite acyclic supplied UD trees and fixed configuration/lexicons/rules, compose lexical entities, predicate frames, clause links, question gaps and sentence offsets. read_with snapshots salient before-context, calls the supplied parser per unit, skips empty parses, concatenates frames and shifts local indices by preceding frame count. scored optionally removes nominal frames and remaps retained edges. lex_table(entity) gives a common noun's animacy and he/she gender from coref::lexicon (never for names; opt-in with PRAG_VN=gender-table, otherwise None): he/she fall back to it when the closed lists are silent, and it never takes an entity the lexicon calls animate.

Pipeline composition requires shared context/configuration and preserved predicate order, not independent child marginals. The seven fragments are partial projections; recursive malformed trees, full lexicon role ranking, all TAM/repair/quotation cases and external active-rule effects remain gaps.
inverse: Universe U pairs admitted supplied inputs/configuration with candidate observations. Exclude a retained local link shifted by any amount other than the preceding frame count, a right unresolved head matching coordination, or a nominal target surviving scored when score-nouns is off. These are inner exclusions for selected projections, not all absent reader behavior.

For observation y retain every supplied tree/context/configuration yielding y under the selected projections. Different surface forms and modifier/provenance fields can share head identity; dropped nominal frames and empty parses leave ambiguous antecedents. No inverse parser or complete antecedent solver is supplied.
limitations: Finite supplied trees and fixed configuration; full recursive reader semantics are not modeled.
No live parser/teacher/corpus/GPU; syntax is partial.
Acyclic/resource/counter premises and active-rule effects remain explicit.
state: Token and frame coordinates must be kept distinct. Sentence-local anchors correspond to last sentence only; Read.pred carries sentence/token coordinates and frame links carry global frame coordinates.
